title.narrative: TOGO Carbon Transaction Facility Readiness and Implementation Support

description.narrative: For a need of overall USD 5 billion for adaptation and mitigation activities explained in the Togo’s NDC[1], only 117 million USD (2019) and 136 million USD (2020)[2] flowed to the country. The carbon market is a source of revenue that the country would like to explore to increase a part of its financing shortfall. In this context, Togo has established a legal framework for the implementation of carbon markets and Article 6 through the Decree 2023–034 that will require a tailored technical support for its implementation. This project is proposed within this framework and aims to address the main challenges faced by the Government of Togo in implementing carbon markets under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement. It focuses on three key outputs: - Output 1: Raised awareness and enhanced capacity of key stakeholders to engage in Article 6 cooperative approaches on an equitable basis- Output 2: Strengthened governance framework and institutional capacities for the implementation of Article 6 by defining a clear strategy and putting in place needed operational procedures for the review and the authorization of mitigation outcomes.By achieving these objectives, the project seeks to create an enabling environment for Togo to fulfill its climate change commitments effectively. The identified problem arises from Togo's need to develop a comprehensive understanding of Article 6 and strengthen its institutional, technical, and operational capacities to establish or participate in carbon markets. By doing so, the country can access additional financial resources to implement its NDC, increase its ambition in climate action, and progress towards a low-carbon development pathway.

This project will support the Government of Togo, led by the Ministry of Environment and Forest Resources (MEFR), to operationalize Decree 2023-034, which established key definitions and a governance structure for Togo’s participation in carbon markets. This will be done by refining Togo’s Article 6 Strategy and developing its Operations Manual, as well as supporting Togo’s new carbon market National Homologation Committee (NHC). The Article 6 Strategy and Operations Manual will build upon existing carbon market elements such as Togo’s tentative/ initial positive list and carbon market definitions contained in the Decree. The project will also deliver targeted Article 6 training and decision support for key government officials to increase their capacity to actively engage in carbon markets
